title: Service agreement records from practice session A

context.question: Who must perform each narrow task, and what does the supplied evidence demonstrate?

controls.evidence_note: Provider host patch attestation is current.
Guest update inventory is missing the required patch.
No current user access review was supplied.
No backup job run record was supplied.
Customer checked the isolated restored report against its approved sample.

artifacts.service-description.txt:
Fictional agreement. No cloud account exists.
A1 Orchard VM is IaaS: the provider maintains physical hosts; the customer operates the guest OS and its deployed report application.
A2 The customer chooses tenant users and data sharing settings.
A3 No managed backup service is purchased. The customer creates workload backup copies.
A4 The customer checks whether a restored report satisfies its business needs. A single historical restore does not show current backup operation.
artifacts.checks.txt:
Synthetic supplied evidence, same review date; no settings were inspected by this lab.
E1 Provider host patch attestation is current. Team claims provider owns host patching.
E2 Guest update inventory is missing the required patch. Team claims provider owns guest patching.
E3 No current user access review was supplied. Team claims customer owns access review.
E4 No backup job run record was supplied. Team claims customer creates backup copies.
E5 Customer checked the isolated restored report against its approved sample. Team claims customer owns restore acceptance.
